statement: The production seven-node in-process cold-formation path used by the mandatory convergence probe completes all six joins and exposes ready table-scoped postgres-wire replicas through every admin endpoint inside the existing budgets by repairing the first violated owner-level liveness invariant; joining, publication, readiness, rebalancer, transport, quorum, and delivery safety remain unchanged, and a deterministic real-owner witness plus an exact source-revert control discriminates the repair before the unchanged full probe turns green.

constraints.statement: If this Quest changes source code, spawn an independent subagent verifier after the last attempt and before landing, and record its Solver verification as subagent:<id>.

Before production fix bytes, reproduce and name the first violated invariant with a deterministic in-process witness through the real owner and interaction. The witness must fail on the sealed base and pass after repair; the seven-node wall-clock probe is corroboration, not the iteration loop.

Consult the closure ledger, relevant historical Quests, current architecture owners, decision tables, and protected coupled-pair contracts before selecting a lever. Finish or repair an existing mechanism; do not add a parallel readiness, publication, routing, retry, or admission authority.

Do not change, skip, reclassify, quarantine, split, weaken, or remove the convergence probe or its change-selection impact. Do not raise its 480-second test timeout, join attempts, join/readiness/admin deadlines, retry budgets, cadence floors, file-size/complexity baselines, or any production timeout.

Preserve quorum, learner promotion, operation-ledger interlock, publication acknowledgement, ready-lease, connection authority, ACK-before-handler, retry/defer, and startup-authority fail-closed semantics. Load may slow progress but may not change correctness or drop an acknowledged obligation.

An exact source-revert or source-mutation control must reach the same real-owner path, preserve non-target behavior, and restore the deterministic liveness failure rather than failing setup or import.

Do not edit, restage, or reinterpret the open formation-transport-message-attribution-interaction aggregate in its separate worktree. This Quest repairs the pre-existing base gate independently and publishes first.
Do not use Docker, GCP, rolling-restart statistics, calibration, or mutable live artifacts. All diagnosis and proof are local deterministic or the unchanged in-process convergence probe.

After guarded landing, publish only with the exact red origin/main head 9bf8bc0df749d1136fe8d19c163ba433d358a0fa named through the repository's --fixes-red authority and a concrete reason; never force-push or bypass tests.
